title: Bottle of Djinn
summary: The Bottle of Djinn used to hold the amulet of an unknown Titan.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
At some point, Klaus acquired the bottle and stored it in one of his vaults, alongside the Spear of Vlad the Impaler.

Dante Vale tricked Klaus into thinking that the team wanted the Bottle of Djinn, when the team was actually after the Spear of Vlad the Impaler. [The Bookshop Hunter]
